title: Introducing Yourself
label: ch:introductions
canDo: I can introduce myself in Arabic, give my name, and understand the other person's name.

payoff.summary: The whole introduction exchange, run once to a man and once to a woman: give a name, ask for one back, and close with tasharrafna; then recall the letters and the pieces each word is built from.
payoff.note: AR-C02-practice (path segment AR-PATH-007) assesses all seventeen atoms of the conversational lessons it follows: the exchange, the letters of ism, mā, anta and tasharrafnā, -ī and -ka/-ki, ism's Semitic kin, mā before a noun, the gendered you and the zero copula. The chapter's other sixteen atoms (the thaman, mudarris and ahlan anchors and the W04-W06 script lessons) come after it in AR-PATH-008, so the payoff cannot honestly require them: 17/33.
